propositions: CLI, MCP, and store entry points currently call emit_shadow_snapshot() and resolve ambient state independently instead of using a single immutable OperationSnapshot per operation
OperationSnapshot must be composed exactly once after input parsing and before lock/network/write, then passed as focused immutable projections through command and store boundaries
Explicit input precedence (explicit > environment > project > user > schema) and independent repository-root selection must be preserved during refactor
Shadow snapshot calls and ambient reloads must be removed after migration, with the ownership checker extended to detect below-boundary ambient reads
Operations must remain unchanged after environment/config/CWD mutation following composition, with new operations observing subsequent changes
Malformed selected configuration must fail before any lock, subprocess, network, or store write effects occur
